steps: Locus and variant specialist: Validate each locus and check linked variants in the focus genes.
QTL and GWAS specialist: Check overlapping QTLs, prior GWAS hits, and known trait genes.
Function and orthology specialist: Assess domains, GO relevance, and characterized orthologs.
Expression and network specialist: Check expression in trait tissues and network proximity.
Literature specialist: Find publications that link the focus genes to the trait.

data.rationale: Dispatch 5 specialists on the top genes of every locus.
